hero.title: Alberto Mañas
hero.subtitle: Software Architect
hero.description: I design and build enterprise systems with Java and TypeScript, specialising in microservice architectures with DDD and hexagonal architecture, CI/CD and deployment on Oracle Cloud (OCI).

roles.description: Responsible for the end-to-end architecture: Next.js and React on the front end, NestJS and Java on the back end, identity with Keycloak and content with Strapi.
highlights: Migrated an entire legacy system to a microservice architecture.
Designed services with DDD and hexagonal architecture, applying design patterns and clean code.
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI for every service.
Configured the OCI infrastructure and moved it to highly available instances.
Agentic workflows with Claude and OpenAI, custom MCP servers and skills for the team.
Architecture documentation with Mermaid and interface design in Figma.

roles.description: End-to-end design and development of the professional website of Antonio De Haro, film composer and touring bassist, from design to production.
highlights: Bilingual website (Spanish and English) built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS and deployed on Vercel.

roles.description: Led the technological transformation of riu.com: a new look and feel built on a modern architecture and advanced caching strategies.
highlights: Designed and implemented a microservice architecture with the team.
Cut response time of the key API endpoints by 30%.
Mentored the new developers joining the team.

roles.description: Fixed issues in the legacy website and the booking flow, and integrated data from the CMS and the core.
highlights: Migrated Java 7 code to LTS versions (8, 11, 17 and 21).

roles.description: Back-end and front-end development for hospitality clients: REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot, and database design with MongoDB and Oracle.

areas.title: Software architecture
areas.description: System design with Domain-Driven Design and hexagonal architecture, applying design patterns, SOLID principles and clean code to keep code maintainable and easy to evolve. Architecture documentation with Mermaid diagrams.

areas.title: DevOps and cloud
areas.description: CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, infrastructure configuration on Oracle Cloud (OCI) and migration to highly available instances. Observability with OpenTelemetry and SigNoz.

areas.title: Back-end and front-end development
areas.description: Services in Java with Spring Boot and in Node.js with NestJS, front ends in Next.js and React. Centralised identity with Keycloak (SSO, OIDC) and content management with Strapi.

areas.title: AI applied to development
areas.description: Agentic workflows with Claude and OpenAI to automate team tasks, custom MCP servers and skills to integrate agents with our tools.

about.title: About me
about.description: I am a Software Architect with more than six years of experience in enterprise software development. I started as a Java backend developer, became Tech Lead at Riu Hotels & Resorts and now work as an architect at Wireless DNA. My work focuses on designing maintainable architectures based on DDD and hexagonal architecture, automating delivery with CI/CD and running reliable systems in the cloud. I also bring AI tools into the development team's workflow.
